entries.text: Error messages, `benchbox --help`, the package READMEs, the root `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `docker/velox/README.md` and the `examples/` guides point at published `https://benchbox.dev/docs/...html` pages instead of repo-relative `docs/...md` paths. The TPC-DS answer-set notes in generated query pages link to the published parity page rather than a GitHub blob, and the results-data deletion procedure link now targets `docs/internal/results-phase-2-runbook.md`, which is where the page lives. `tests/unit/cli/test_shipped_docs_urls.py` pins the URL shape and checks each published URL against the site-owned page set in `quality/docs-ownership.json`.
